profile_text.body:
Shopify describes itself as an all-in-one commerce platform for businesses. Its website says it offers more than ecommerce software, with tools to manage every part of a business, and invites users to try Shopify free. The company says businesses can build or grow fast with AI.

On the AI side, Shopify promotes discovery across AI channels and says shoppers can check out right in the chat, with no effort from the merchant. It attributes this to Agentic Storefronts.

Shopify Inc. is a public, for-profit company headquartered in Ottawa. It trades under the ticker SHOP. The company is also known as Shopify Inc. and Shopify Inc - Class A.
